tags.name: Auth
tags.description:
JWT Token used to authorize API-requests
The authorization process is possible upon the availability of a JWT-token, using which each subsequent query to the API should be signed.
JWT-Token is passed in the header of any request, except when the token itself is received, when this code is not required:
```json
"Authorization": "Bearer: {JWT-token}"
```
To receive a JWT-token, you need to send a request passing the api-key from the “SMPP/API Password” tab of the Integrations & API section in [your personal account](https://app.bsg.world/integration/remote).

tags.name: Campaign RCS
tags.description:
General rules for sending messages 

- Successful sending of an RCS message is possible only under certain conditions:
  - RCS agent is registered for the client and is in active status
  - Recipient’s phone number: 
    - supports the ability to receive RCS notifications
    - is not in the RCS stop list (if the stop list check was enabled in the request to send the message)
- In API requests to send RCS messages, the list of recipients’ phone numbers must be unique (no duplicates) 
- The maximum allowed number of contacts in one campaign is 5000 
- If the created campaign contains messages to subscribers from countries that do not match the RCS agent, such messages will not be sent. You will be able to view the campaign statistics and details of its messages after sending

**Sending RCS messages in the TEST Mode Account**
  
In the test mode of the account, the client can send RCS messages on behalf of the test agent (permission to use it must be agreed with the manager in advance). 
Withdrawals for sending RCS messages on behalf of the test agent are made from the client’s credit/own funds on the balance sheet. 
Sending an RCS message in test mode is allowed only to a verified contact (the recipient’s phone number that has been confirmed by the client via a code).

**Billing of RCS messages**
The RCS message is charged at the expense of the client’s principal balance and credit limit.
Billing is performed only for RCS messages with the status Delivered.
The cost of an RCS message in the customer’s tariff depends on the direction of delivery;
RCS message type (text, single card/carousel).
If you use an alternative SMS channel, the message is charged at the price of an SMS message according to the connected tariff on your account.
If the client’s balance runs out of funds while sending messages, the created campaign is paused (the campaign is assigned the “Paused” status). After replenishing the balance, to continue sending messages, you need to resume the campaign yourself.

**Webhook**
By configuring the URL for the webhook in your personal account on the [Integration and API page](https://app.bsg.world/integration/remote), in the Callback URL For RCS field, you can receive reports with the status of RCS messages sent.

tags.name: Campaign SMS
tags.description:
BSG Campaign SMS API is a RESTful API for send both single and group SMS. 

- You can send number of SMS by a single request with the [same text](#operation/sms_send) or use [different text for each number](#operation/sms_send_individual).
- You can pass list of phone numbers or use address book stored earlier and reused. Try [send-groups](#operation/sms_send_groups)
- You can use templates to personalize message for every receiver.
- You can use automatically created [short links](#tag/Short-Links) to detect which of them specifically clicked on the link from your message.

tags.name: Contact
tags.description:
API provides you an opportunity to manage contacts for subsequent single and multiple uses when conducting SMS, Viber, or Number Verification campaigns. You can create new contacts, view, edit, group, delete existing contacts.
Also you can combine contacts to lists and store additional field to personalize your messages. 

For example you can send messages to list of your contacts about following event and use personal contact name in every message to looks more friendly.  
So you can:

- Manage contacts
- Manage custom fields
- Manage contact lists

tags.name: Short Links
tags.description:
BSG Short Urls API is a RESTful API for instant short links in campaign messages to track clicks geography and campaign performance.

Start using Short Urls by your [account](https://app.bsg.world/url-shortener/links) or API. 

**Stand out with shorter, branded, and trackable URLs**

tags.name: Short Domains
tags.description:
You also can use your own short domains for short links. Just add it to your 
[account](https://app.bsg.world/url-shortener/domains) by UI or using this API

Using those methods you can list, add, update and delete your personal domains.

**Please note:** after adding domain you have to setup dns on your side to correctly resolve domain name to our ip.
It’s necessary to add A-record and CNAME to your dns. To read more please click "Add domain" in your [account](https://app.bsg.world/url-shortener/domains)

tags.name: 2FA OTP
tags.description:
BSG 2FA API is a RESTful API for two-factor user authentication on a website or web application: you can use it to confirm a transaction, and user contact information, as a second factor in user authentication, and more.
BSG 2FA API provides a choice of channel for sending a one-time password (OTP) to a user: SMS or Viber. Connect the channel you need in your personal account on the “Settings” page of the “2FA” section and start working with the BSG 2FA API.

**Please note:** 2FA API is not available for use in DEMO account modes (modes in which your account data is not verified). 

Make sure that you have entered all the necessary data in your account settings in order to use the 2FA service. 

**Be reliable. Use 2FA**
